saints.name: St. Brigid of Ireland
saints.title: Abbess
saints.shortBlurb: The great abbess of Kildare, honored with Patrick and Columba as a patron of Ireland, whose boundless charity to the poor filled the memory of her people…
biography: Born in Ireland in the fifth century, Brigid embraced the consecrated life while still young and, according to ancient tradition, founded the great monastery of Kildare, a center of learning and holiness that she governed as abbess. Around her grew one of the most important religious communities of the early Irish Church.

The lives written of her overflow with tales of tireless generosity to the poor and the sick, and she has been honored for centuries, together with Saints Patrick and Columba, as a patron of Ireland. She died about the year 525 and was buried at Kildare.
saints.knownFor: Her monastery of Kildare and her legendary charity to the poor.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 1 February
